g.text: Immutable release: validation, one-registry authorization, and public-byte proof
sync versions; prove clean source; create tag
stop; do not authorize a registry
Repair source and mint the next release candidate.
Published versions and release tags are immutable.
[one owner and one registry, in dependency order]
issue short-lived credential; publish immutable bytes
install in clean directory; exercise behavior
record coordinate, digest, run, and smoke result
Retry only if the registry confirms that no version was accepted.
Wrong public bytes require the next release candidate.
scoped npm only: latest := RC; remove bootstrap; deprecate 0.0.0
prove next = latest = RC; legacy latest remains 2.0.4
